title: Analytics Export
subtitle: Download an Excel-friendly ZIP of historical data, pre-aggregated for analysis. Raw rows stay in the database; only summaries are exported (typically a few MB).

sensors.label: Sensor readings
sensors.hint: substrate moisture, EC, temp, humidity, pH (aggregated by hour/day)

fertigation.label: Fertigation events
fertigation.hint: water + nutrient volumes per zone, computed from relay events

automations.label: Automation history
automations.hint: success / failure / skipped per automation (with reasons in raw view)

reference.label: Reference data
reference.hint: lab readings, AMIC cycles, agronomist reports, operational plans

trendInclude: Include trend/ folder with all-time daily aggregates
rawWarning_one: Raw samples for {{count}} day may produce a multi-million-row file. Excel can only open files with up to ~1M rows per sheet.
rawWarning_other: Raw samples for {{count}} days may produce a multi-million-row file. Excel can only open files with up to ~1M rows per sheet.
zipNote: Each ZIP contains a README.txt with row counts and a column dictionary. CSVs are UTF-8 with BOM and ISO timestamps for Excel compatibility.

toast.pickDomain: Pick at least one data domain
